_readme: Photo slot map for build.py. Each slot names a file in site/media/photos (extension optional). A slot may also be an object {"file": ..., "position": ..., "alt": ...} to override the defaults recorded under files. When a card would repeat a photo already shown on the same page, the build swaps in a sibling photo from the same category automatically. Add alt text and an object-position under files for every new photo. Optional banner_position under files sets the vertical focal point used only in the wide, short page banners.
